description: Make HEADED the default with graceful headless auto-fallback, and add the overlay configuration surface. Flip the headless defaults in both src/config.ts and src/browser.ts, wrap the Playwright launch in a try/catch that retries headless (logging a stderr warning) when a headed launch fails (no display server), and add all overlay config knobs (LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY plus sub-knobs) parsed once in config.ts following the existing env-parsing patterns. This feature is the foundation the overlay module (FEAT-002) and loop narration (FEAT-003) build on. Depends on nothing; must land first.
steps: In src/config.ts: change the headless default from `overrides.headless ?? envBoolDefaultTrue(env.LAYA_BROWSER_HEADLESS)` to a default-FALSE parse so headed is the default — headless only when LAYA_BROWSER_HEADLESS === "true" (reuse the existing envBoolDefaultFalse helper). Update the file's env doc comment block accordingly (LAYA_BROWSER_HEADLESS now defaults to headed; `true` runs headless).

In src/config.ts: extend LayaBrowserConfig, ConfigOverrides, and loadConfig() with an `overlay` config object. Suggested shape: { enabled: boolean; mode: 'auto'|'on'|'off'; accent: string (default '#a855f7'); typingEffect: boolean (default false); waitCountdown: boolean (default false); debugSeeElements: boolean (default false); activityLog: boolean (default true) }. Parse from env: LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY (auto|on|off, default 'auto' = on in headed, off in headless), LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY_ACCENT (hex color, default #a855f7), LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY_TYPING (default false), LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY_COUNTDOWN (default false), LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY_DEBUG (default false), LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY_LOG (default true). 'auto' resolves to enabled = !headless. Keep parsing pure/side-effect-free and never-throw (malformed -> default), matching the existing style. Validate the accent as a #rrggbb / #rgb hex, else fall back to #a855f7.

In src/config.ts: also add a configurable Autopilot WAIT duration knob (e.g. `autopilotWaitMs`) parsed from LAYA_AUTOPILOT_WAIT_MS (default lower than the current 500, e.g. 300; clamp to a sane min like 0 and a max like 5000). This feeds the loop's WAIT operation in FEAT-003.

In src/browser.ts: change the constructor default `headless: options.headless ?? true` to `?? false` so a bare BrowserSession is headed by default, and update the BrowserSessionOptions.headless doc comment (Defaults to false / headed).

In src/browser.ts launch(): wrap the `browserType.launch(...)` call so that if a HEADED launch (headless === false) throws (e.g. 'Missing X server' / no display), it logs a single warning to process.stderr (never stdout — stdio JSON-RPC integrity) like `[laya-browser-mcp] headed launch failed (<msg>); falling back to headless.` and retries the launch with headless: true. A headless launch that fails is a real error and should propagate. Track the effective headless mode on the session (e.g. a private field / getter) so the overlay module in FEAT-002 can decide auto on/off, and so nothing else regresses.

In src/server.ts: thread the new overlay config from LayaBrowserConfig into the BrowserSessionOptions (add an `overlay` option to BrowserSessionOptions in browser.ts) so the session receives the resolved overlay settings and the autopilot WAIT ms reaches run_goal/loop context (add to RunGoalContext / pass through in the run_goal registration). Keep Boundary Discipline: config parsed once, handed inward.
In src/index.ts: update the top-of-file env doc comment to note headed is now the default and mention LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY.

Update README.md configuration reference table: LAYA_BROWSER_HEADLESS default is now headed (set `true` for headless); add rows for LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY and its sub-knobs and LAYA_AUTOPILOT_WAIT_MS. Keep the table style consistent with the existing one.
acceptance_criteria: loadConfig() with an empty env returns headless === false (headed default).
loadConfig() exposes a typed `overlay` object with enabled resolving from mode 'auto' to !headless, accent defaulting to #a855f7, typingEffect false, waitCountdown false by default.

A new BrowserSession() (no options) has headless === false by default at the option level, but launch() transparently falls back to headless when a headed launch throws, writing exactly one warning to stderr and no output to stdout.
npm run typecheck is clean and npm run build emits dist/.
Existing test suite still passes (config.test.ts assertions updated to reflect the new headed default where they asserted the old default).
verification: Run `npm run test` — all previously-passing tests pass (update config.test.ts expectations for the new headed default as part of this feature).
Run `npm run build` — emits dist/ without error.
findings: Implemented headed-by-default with graceful headless auto-fallback plus the full overlay config surface. Files: src/config.ts (headless now envBoolDefaultFalse -> headed default; added OverlayMode/OverlayConfig types, OVERLAY_MODES, DEFAULT_OVERLAY_ACCENT #a855f7, DEFAULT/MIN/MAX_AUTOPILOT_WAIT_MS constants; loadConfig now parses LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY (auto|on|off, auto resolves enabled=!headless), LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY_ACCENT (hex-validated via parseHexColor, else fallback), TYPING/COUNTDOWN/DEBUG default false, LOG default true, and autopilotWaitMs from LAYA_AUTOPILOT_WAIT_MS default 300 clamped 0..5000; overlay/autopilotWaitMs added to LayaBrowserConfig + ConfigOverrides; parsing stays pure/never-throw). src/browser.ts (constructor default headless ?? false; added `overlay` to BrowserSessionOptions; added private effectiveHeadless field + public `headless` getter; launch() wraps browserType.launch in try/catch: a headed launch that throws logs exactly ONE stderr warning `[laya-browser-mcp] headed launch failed (<msg>); falling back to headless.` and retries headless:true, a headless failure propagates; effectiveHeadless tracks the mode actually used). src/server.ts (threads config.overlay into BrowserSessionOptions and config.autopilotWaitMs into the run_goal handler as waitMs). src/tools/run_goal.ts (RunGoalContext.waitMs added and forwarded to runGoal). src/index.ts (updated env doc comment). README.md (config table updated: LAYA_BROWSER_HEADLESS default now headed, added LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY + 5 sub-knobs + LAYA_AUTOPILOT_WAIT_MS rows). test/config.test.ts (added 6 tests for headed default, overlay defaults/auto/on/off, accent hex validation, sub-knobs, and WAIT ms clamp). VERIFICATION: `npm run typecheck` clean; `npm run test` = 145 passed / 3 skipped (base was 139 passed / 3 skipped; +6 new config tests; the 3 skips — real-weights Autopilot, WebKit launch, pnpm bench report — are all pre-existing, verified via git stash); `npm run build` emits dist/. REAL-WORLD TEST: ran a bare `new BrowserSession()` against dist/ in this no-display sandbox — headed launch failed as expected, logged exactly one stderr warning, fell back to headless, drove a page successfully, effectiveHeadless flipped to true, and stdout stayed empty (JSON-RPC integrity confirmed). NOTE for later features: BrowserSession exposes the effective headless mode via the `headless` getter so FEAT-002's overlay can resolve `auto` against the mode the browser actually runs in (important because the sandbox always falls back to headless).
